# Cratis Studio

> Cratis Studio is an optional commercial workspace for collaborative event modeling within Cratis Platform. Developers, domain experts and product owners use it to brainstorm events and discuss commands, read models, specifications and screen prototypes. See the site for account access, pricing and service terms.

Use Studio when your team needs a shared model of expected behavior. Modeling does not replace implementation, testing or operation of your application. Studio is not required to use Chronicle, Arc or Components.

## Cratis Studio

- [Cratis Studio](https://cratis.studio/): What Cratis Studio is, its features and how it works.
- [The vision](https://cratis.studio/vision.html): Why Cratis Studio exists. A Markdown version is at https://cratis.studio/vision.md.
- [Pricing](https://cratis.studio/#pricing): Published 14-day free trial and per-seat plans, monthly or yearly.
- [Privacy policy](https://cratis.studio/privacy-policy.html)
- [Terms and conditions](https://cratis.studio/terms-and-conditions.html)

## Cratis

- [Cratis documentation](https://www.cratis.io/): Start here to build directly with Cratis Platform. Chronicle handles event storage and projections; Arc handles application commands and queries, including without event sourcing; Components provides optional React UI.
- [Event modeling documentation](https://www.cratis.io/event-modeling/): Event modeling with Cratis.
- [Cratis engineering blog](https://blog.cratis.io): Articles from the Cratis engineers.
- [Cratis](https://cratis.no): The organization behind Cratis Platform and Cratis Studio.
- [Cratis on GitHub](https://github.com/Cratis): The open-source Cratis repositories.
